description: Enforcement actions across regulators and jurisdictions, with structured penalty data where it has been parsed: entity penalised, amount, currency, breach categories, and whether the penalty is final. Use for "what has this regulator fined firms for", "has this firm been penalised", or precedent research on a breach type. IMPORTANT: only about a quarter of enforcement records have a parsed penalty amount — extraction requires full source text, which many records lack. Do NOT answer "what are the largest fines" from sort=largest_penalty alone: it ranks only the parsed subset. Check the `note` field, which reports how many actions were excluded. Amounts are never converted between currencies.

entity.description: Case-insensitive substring of the penalised firm or individual name.

final_only.description: Only penalties recorded as final, excluding proposed or under appeal.

min_penalty.description: Minimum penalty amount, in the currency of the record — amounts are NOT converted between currencies, so combine this with `currency` if you need comparable figures.

sort.description: Default "newest". "largest_penalty" excludes records with no amount.

with_penalty_amount_only.description: Only records carrying a structured penalty amount. IMPORTANT: this is a small minority of enforcement records — most enforcement actions are indexed without a parsed figure. Leaving this false returns the full enforcement picture; setting it true returns only what is quantified.

name: regmonitoring_search_enforcement
title: Search enforcement actions
